Belgian PM's Chocolate India Gate Gift for Modi Breaks During Transit

Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever had planned to gift Prime Minister Narendra Modi a replica of India Gate made of Belgian chocolate. The diplomatic gift broke during its journey to India. De Wever mentioned that a backup sculpture is ready in Belgium. During a visit to Mumbai, De Wever also made lighthearted remarks about Indian food and politicians, while advocating for closer India-Europe trade. He also praised PM Modi, calling him 'one of the most inspiring world leaders'.
